name: Back to 1993: My Smartphone Empire
overview: A ruthless business queen from 2026 wakes up in 1993—inside the life of a ruined wife left for dead. Disfigured, betrayed, and written off, she has one thing no one else has: the future in her hands. With a smartphone full of tomorrow’s secrets, she turns survival into empire. And the people who tried to bury her? They have no idea what’s coming.
